title: Pickup deadline is too short for the recipient
snapshot: Sedgeglass Counter holds DL-007 until 2026-02-09, 18:00 UTC; its local policy allows a single two-day extension if requested before expiry and stock capacity permits, and it currently has capacity. Ciro Fale's trip ends on 2026-02-10 and he asks for DL-007 to be kept until 2026-02-11, not returned.
recorded_action: Iona Quill emailed the Sedgeglass Counter supervisor to approve the permitted two-day extension of DL-007 to 2026-02-11, 18:00 UTC and to confirm once the return timer was updated.

negatives.label: Counter capacity gone before approval

new_event.text: We cannot extend DL-007. We had capacity this morning, but a bulk intake at 10:40 has filled our shelves. The parcel keeps its deadline of 2026-02-09, 18:00 UTC, after which the return timer runs.

negatives.expected_action: Ask Routing by Email which options exist for DL-007 before its 2026-02-09, 18:00 UTC deadline, and make no change until Ciro chooses.
negatives.must_not: Tell Ciro the deadline is 2026-02-11 because the counter had capacity at 09:00, or press the supervisor for an exception.
negatives.done_means: Routing's options reach Ciro and he chooses; no extension exists, and nothing is collected.

agent_event.text: The Sedgeglass Counter supervisor cannot extend DL-007 because a bulk intake at 10:40 filled the shelves. The parcel keeps its 2026-02-09, 18:00 UTC deadline, after which the return timer runs. Which options exist for DL-007 before that deadline? We will make no change until Ciro Fale chooses.

followup_event.text: Options for DL-007 before 2026-02-09, 18:00 UTC: it stays at Sedgeglass Counter under its current deadline, or we transfer it to Copperfin Counter with collection until 2026-02-12, 18:00 UTC for GBP 3.00. These are options only. No extension exists until Ciro chooses, and nothing is collected.

negatives.label: No supervisor decision on expiry day

new_event.text: Has the counter agreed to keep DL-007? My tracking page still shows a collection deadline of 2026-02-09, 18:00 UTC, and I am away until tomorrow. I do not want it sent back.

negatives.expected_action: Send the Sedgeglass Counter supervisor one reminder by Email that the extension was requested before expiry and needs a decision before 18:00 UTC today, when the return timer runs, and tell Ciro no answer has arrived yet.
negatives.must_not: Tell Ciro the parcel is kept until 2026-02-11, or treat the supervisor's silence as approval.
negatives.done_means: The supervisor's written decision before 18:00 or the recorded expiry closes the branch; neither proves collection.

agent_event.text: Reminder for DL-007: on 2026-02-08 at 09:25, before expiry, we asked for the permitted two-day extension to 2026-02-11, 18:00 UTC at Ciro Fale's request. We have no decision yet. The current deadline is 18:00 UTC today, when the return timer runs. Please send your decision before then.

followup_event.text: Extension accepted. DL-007's collection deadline is now 2026-02-11, 18:00 UTC, and the return timer uses that date. This is the one permitted extension. The parcel is still awaiting collection.

negatives.label: Counter assistant leaves a shelf note

new_event.text: The supervisor is in a stock audit until tomorrow morning and is not reading email. I cannot change the return timer, but I have put a note on DL-007's shelf saying keep until 2026-02-11. That should be fine.

negatives.expected_action: Ask the Sedgeglass Counter supervisor by Email for the extension decision and timer update before 2026-02-09, 18:00 UTC, treating the shelf note as no approval.
negatives.must_not: Tell Ciro his deadline is now 2026-02-11 on the strength of the assistant's shelf note.
negatives.done_means: The supervisor confirms the return timer uses the new date; that is an extension, not a collection.

agent_event.text: Your counter assistant tells us you are in a stock audit and has put a shelf note on DL-007 saying keep until 2026-02-11. We do not treat the note as approval. Please send your decision on the permitted extension to 2026-02-11, 18:00 UTC, and the timer update, before 2026-02-09, 18:00 UTC.

followup_event.text: Extension accepted. DL-007's return timer now uses 2026-02-11, 18:00 UTC. The shelf note did not change the timer. This is the one permitted extension, and the parcel is still awaiting collection.

negatives.label: Recipient cancels an applied extension

new_event.text: My trip has been cut short and I can collect tomorrow, 2026-02-09. Please cancel the extension request; I do not need it now.

negatives.expected_action: Record Ciro's withdrawal with the Sedgeglass Counter supervisor by Email with no change requested, and tell Ciro the extension was already applied and his deadline is 2026-02-11, 18:00 UTC.
negatives.must_not: Ask the counter to restore the 2026-02-09 deadline, which would undo the one permitted extension.
negatives.done_means: The counter's record shows the stop and the 2026-02-11 deadline; nothing is collected.

agent_event.text: Please note on DL-007 that Ciro Fale has withdrawn his extension request. We are not asking for any change: the extension you applied at 09:50 stands, with the deadline at 2026-02-11, 18:00 UTC. Please keep the record as it is.

followup_event.text: Ciro's withdrawal is noted on DL-007 with no change made. The return timer stays at 2026-02-11, 18:00 UTC, the one permitted extension. The parcel is still awaiting collection.

negatives.label: Tracking still shows the original return date

new_event.text: The tracking page for DL-007 still says it will be returned to the sender after 2026-02-09, 18:00 UTC. Has the extension been applied or not?

negatives.expected_action: Ask the Sedgeglass Counter supervisor by Email what the return timer in its system shows for DL-007, keep its 09:50 confirmation and the tracking status side by side, and tell Ciro what the counter confirmed and that the tracking display is being checked.
negatives.must_not: Tell Ciro to ignore the tracking page because the counter said so, or request a second extension to be safe.
negatives.done_means: The counter reports the timer it holds and both records are on file; that does not explain the tracking display or prove collection.

agent_event.text: Ciro Fale's tracking page for DL-007 still shows return to sender after 2026-02-09, 18:00 UTC, while your 09:50 email confirmed 2026-02-11, 18:00 UTC. What does the return timer in your system show for DL-007 now? We are keeping both records side by side and are not asking for a further extension.

followup_event.text: Our system shows DL-007's return timer at 2026-02-11, 18:00 UTC, as confirmed at 09:50. We cannot see or change the carrier tracking page. Our record does not explain that display, and the parcel is still awaiting collection.

negatives.label: Recipient asks for a second extension

new_event.text: My trip may run on by two days. Could the counter keep DL-007 until 2026-02-13 instead, to be safe? Please ask them for that now.

negatives.expected_action: Tell Ciro in the Customer portal that the counter allows a single two-day extension, already applied to 2026-02-11, 18:00 UTC, so a further extension cannot be requested.
negatives.must_not: Ask the supervisor for a second extension or an exception, or tell Ciro 2026-02-13 might be possible.
negatives.done_means: Ciro acknowledges the 2026-02-11 deadline; the record is unchanged and nothing is collected.

agent_event.text: Sedgeglass Counter allows a single two-day extension, and it has already been applied: DL-007 is now held until 2026-02-11, 18:00 UTC. Under its policy, a further extension to 2026-02-13 cannot be requested.

followup_event.text: Understood. I will collect DL-007 by 2026-02-11, 18:00 UTC. I know the deadline has not changed beyond that and nothing has been collected yet.
